# Lost updates

<!-- bullets: 1.1.a -->

Two sessions that read a balance and write it back can overwrite each other, and `READ COMMITTED` does not stop that (`pg-iso#XACT-READ-COMMITTED`).

```java snippet=m01-l1/LostUpdate.java
public final class LostUpdate { static long balance = 100; public static void main(String[] args) { long seen = balance; balance = seen + 50; System.out.println("balance after the second writer overwrote the first one: " + balance); } }
```

```sql
UPDATE account SET balance = balance + 50 WHERE id = 1; -- one atomic statement, no lost update
```

```yaml
isolation: read-committed
```

:::judgement{source="Google, Site Reliability Engineering, ch. 17" ref="sre-book#ch17"}
According to the SRE book, a test that cannot fail tells you nothing about reliability.
:::
